description: This file is an ESLint configuration module for a Vue.js project written in TypeScript. It imports various ESLint plugins and configurations, and defines rules for linting source files in the project, including TypeScript, Vue, and Vitest test files.

methods.name: defineConfigWithVueTs
methods.description: Defines the ESLint configuration with Vue and TypeScript support, accepting configuration objects for files and ignores, and combining multiple plugin configurations.
